dataset: HHMI Janelia MaleCNS v1.0, minconf-0.5 annotated neuronal domain
model: dimensionless contractive signed rate model, gain 0.8, alpha 0.25; not upstream Brian2 LIF
recovery_definition: 1 - ||candidate_motor - intact_motor||_F / ||lesion_motor - intact_motor||_F; not a biological recovery rate
limitations: Only two artificially driven descending neurons; one uncalibrated dynamics hypothesis and one anatomical specimen.
POD retains the internal 64-neuron operator and all 64 boundary ports. Four latent states do not mean four replacement biological neurons, whole-brain compression or measured speedup.
High recovery also occurs with internal shuffle, so these experiments do not demonstrate necessity of precise internal wiring.
Unknown/modulatory fast neurotransmitter signs are explicitly zero while anatomical rows remain preserved.
No biological validation, living tissue, embodied simulation, walking or upstream LIF execution was demonstrated.
